ENGLISH LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ENGLISH LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which word begins with the voiced sound /d/? (1 mark)
   A. few
   B. den
   C. ten
   D. fan

2. Which situation fits 'Little by little fills the measure'? (1 mark)
   A. Picking up a little rubbish every day until the compound is clean
   B. Sleeping late
   C. Getting a big prize at once
   D. Losing a shoe

3. Which foods mainly give us energy? (1 mark)
   A. Ugali, rice and potatoes
   B. Water and tea
   C. Vitamins only
   D. Salt and pepper

4. To skim a text means to (1 mark)
   A. copy it
   B. look for one word only
   C. read quickly to get the main idea
   D. memorise it

5. What should you do to listen fluently to a speech? (1 mark)
   A. Look at your phone
   B. Draw during the speech
   C. Face the speaker and listen for the main points
   D. Talk to a friend

6. Which is NOT one of the three parts of reading fluency? (1 mark)
   A. Handwriting
   B. Accuracy
   C. Expression
   D. Speed

7. Which word is an adverb of time? (1 mark)
   A. quietly
   B. upstairs
   C. yesterday
   D. here

8. Which question is correct for asking about the owner of some boots? (1 mark)
   A. Whose are boot these?
   B. Whose is these boots?
   C. Who boots are these?
   D. Whose boots are these?

9. Which sentence uses the sense of smell? (1 mark)
   A. The soap gives off a fresh smell.
   B. The tap drips.
   C. The wall is white.
   D. The towel is rough.

10. What does 'Prevention is better than cure' mean? (1 mark)
   A. Medicine is always better
   B. Avoid all doctors
   C. It is better to stop a problem than to solve it later
   D. Cure is easy

11. What is the plural of 'potato'? (1 mark)
   A. potatoies
   B. potatos
   C. potatoes
   D. potatoos

12. What is the plural of 'tooth'? (1 mark)
   A. teeths
   B. toothes
   C. teeth
   D. tooths

13. A red octagon sign with the word STOP tells drivers to (1 mark)
   A. stop completely
   B. park
   C. turn on lights
   D. go faster

14. What is the superlative of 'good'? (1 mark)
   A. best
   B. better
   C. most good
   D. goodest

15. Which word has the short vowel /ɪ/? (1 mark)
   A. feel
   B. seat
   C. live
   D. leave

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Cross out the silent letter in each word: write, lamb, honest, listen. (2 marks)

17. Arrange in order and write as a paragraph: (a) Finally, we went home. (b) We arrived at the farm at nine. (c) Then we fed the goats. (3 marks)

18. Give directions from your classroom to the school gate using at least three prepositions. (3 marks)

19. List three things a child must never give to a stranger online. (3 marks)

20. Explain the proverb 'A stitch in time saves nine'. (2 marks)

21. Write the plurals of: bus, story, wolf, mouse. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ENGLISH LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #2 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — den
   Den starts with /d/, which makes your throat buzz. Ten starts with /t/ and fan and few with /f/.

2. A — Picking up a little rubbish every day until the compound is clean
   Small efforts add up.

3. A — Ugali, rice and potatoes
   They are carbohydrates.

4. C — read quickly to get the main idea
   Skimming gives you the general idea.

5. C — Face the speaker and listen for the main points
   Active listening means paying attention to the main points.

6. A — Handwriting
   Fluency is accuracy, speed and expression.

7. C — yesterday
   'Yesterday' tells when.

8. D — Whose boots are these?
   'Whose' is followed by a noun.

9. A — The soap gives off a fresh smell.
   'Fresh smell' refers to smell.

10. C — It is better to stop a problem than to solve it later
   Stopping problems early saves effort.

11. C — potatoes
   Some nouns ending in o add es.

12. C — teeth
   Tooth is irregular.

13. A — stop completely
   A stop sign means stop.

14. A — best
   Good, better, best.

15. C — live
   'Live' has a short /ɪ/.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: write (w), lamb (b), honest (h), listen (t)
   Working / marking points: Half a mark for each.

17. (3 marks)
   Answer: We arrived at the farm at nine. Then we fed the goats. Finally, we went home.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each sentence in the correct place.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example: Go out of the classroom, walk along the corridor and go past the office to the gate.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct preposition.

19. (3 marks)
   Answer: Name, home address, school name, password.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each, up to 3.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: Fixing a small problem early stops it becoming a bigger problem that takes more work.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for fixing early and 1 for avoiding bigger work.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: buses, stories, wolves, mice
   Working / marking points: Half a mark for each.
